text:
Priya: noticed a burst of tiny-gang evicts in eu-west1 ~08:05, a few customer jobs restarted.

Mike: saw the spike too. paste?

Priya: ```W0830 08:05:12 scheduler.go:preempt preempting pod=batch-train-42
I0830 08:05:13 provisioner: scale-up triggered gpu-pool 4->8
I0830 08:05:14 kubelet: pod batch-train-42 evicted: preemption```

Anya: scale-up happened but nodes not Ready before evictions. AZ mismatch?

Chris: provisioner created in eu-west1-b while pods had strict affinity for eu-west1-c; cloud flavor returned 429 so fallback scattered gangs -> GPU fragmentation.

Priya: proposal: zone-aware "provision_stabilize" hold (default 30s) where scheduler suppresses aggressive preempt if a same-zone scale-up is in flight.

Mike: +1. emit metric scheduler.provisioner_cooldown_mismatch and add Grafana panel overlaying scale-ups, cloud 429s, and preemptions.

Anya: gate per-zone only.

Chris: config sketch: ```scheduler.provisionStabilizeWindow=30s; scheduler.zoneAware=true```

Priya: opening PR and will canary in staging with trace replay. PR: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/842

ops-bot: alert: eu-west1 preemptions >40 in 5m

sre-oncall: investigating. tagging P2. will update.

Priya: canary replay: preempts down ~75%, node Ready latency same. rolling to prod with 1h ramp. closing when stable. :white_check_mark:
